accueil.titre: Your nights deserve the best hostesses.
accueil.sous_titre: DamUp connects table hostesses with bars, restaurants, clubs and lounges. No more word of mouth: bookings, applications and confirmations are all managed in one place.
accueil.etab_titre: Venues: find your hostesses in minutes
accueil.etab_1_p: Date, hours, number of hostesses and perks offered (drinks, meals, shisha…).
accueil.etab_2_p: Photos, reviews from other venues and each hostess's reliability.
accueil.etab_3_p: Each selected hostess confirms she's coming; without confirmation, the spot opens up for someone else.
accueil.etab_4_p: Scan the hostess's QR code on arrival, then leave a review after the night.
accueil.hot_titre: Hostesses: bookings near you, with confidence
accueil.hot_1_p: Create your profile and apply without paying.
accueil.hot_2_t: All the terms before you apply
accueil.hot_2_p: Location, hours, perks offered and photos of the venue.
accueil.hot_3_p: Venues never see your phone number, your Instagram or your email.
accueil.hot_4_p: Every completed booking strengthens your profile.
accueil.frise_1_p: Create your account; it is verified by the DamUp team.
accueil.frise_3_p: The venue picks, the hostess confirms she's coming.
accueil.frise_4_p: QR code at the door, review after the booking.
accueil.conf_1_p: Every hostess and every venue is approved before using DamUp. 18 and over only.
accueil.conf_2_p: A problem? Report it from the app; the DamUp team steps in.
accueil.conf_3_p: Launching in Paris and the surrounding region.
accueil.faq_1_r: Free for hostesses. Venues take out a subscription to post bookings; the price is shared with them before any payment.
accueil.faq_2_r: Hostesses aged 18 and over, and registered venues (bars, restaurants, clubs, lounges) with a SIRET number.
accueil.faq_3_q: Why does my account need to be approved?
accueil.faq_3_r: For everyone's safety: the DamUp team checks every profile before activating it.
accueil.faq_4_q: What happens if I don't confirm I'm coming?
accueil.faq_4_r: After acceptance you have 12 hours to confirm (3 hours if the booking is within 24 hours). Without confirmation, the spot is offered to another hostess.
accueil.faq_5_q: What if I need to cancel?
accueil.faq_5_r: You can cancel from the app up until the booking starts. Cancelling after confirmation leaves a strike on your profile, removed after 3 completed bookings.
accueil.faq_6_r: Venues see your first name, age, city, photos and reviews, only when you apply to their bookings. Your contact details stay private.
accueil.faq_7_q: How do I pay for the subscription?
accueil.faq_7_r: In cash against a receipt, or online by card or direct debit when that option is available.
